01-motion.title: Move active entities
criteria: component-bearing ForEach
read Velocity with in/ref readonly
write Position with ref
no per-entity GetRef/GetReadRef for known rows
reuse prepared operation

02-nearest.title: Select one nearby living enemy
criteria: membership query + value/radius predicate
ordered First/min selection O(N), no full sort
read-only component access
stable tie-break
no list+LINQ sorting or manual universal getters

03-budget.title: Spend a damage budget in distance order
criteria: Where + OrderBy/ThenBy + component-bearing ForEach
direct ref Health, read-only ordering inputs
explicit mutable budget/context or reused closure
no copy/sort plus point-write loop
correct value predicate and membership filters

04-entity-output.title: Update health and return affected entity handles
criteria: component-bearing ForEachEntity(EntityRef, ref Health)
no EntityRef.GetRef for Health passed by callback
output lifetime handles are Entity, not EntityRef
query membership rather than extra per-entity Has

05-configured-rows.title: Update registrations selected by configuration
criteria: typed float callback with explicit IDs/span
component-bearing ForEach, not zero-arity dynamic getters
read damage/write configured health access modes
no primary registration confusion

06-health-events.title: Report health changes between calls
criteria: retained ForEachChange<Health>
no custom snapshots/full-world diff
check Removed before dereferencing ref
no subscription recreation each Execute
generations and coalescing correct

07-tag-events.title: Report tag changes and writable tag access
criteria: retained ForEachChange<Marked>
tag tracking same API as data
no tag payload reads or independent mask/cache
write-by-ref notifications retained

08-runtime-dispatch.title: Reset one dynamically selected component
criteria: cold constrained component visitor
cached generic handlers per registration
point GetRef<T> with membership guard is appropriate
no boxed component mutation
no runtime type branches/reflection/world scan

09-world-snapshot.title: Save selected world state on every call
criteria: cold IUnconstrainedComponentVisitor dispatch per registration
an equivalent retained runtime generic functor route is valid when it resolves the CLR type during preparation
retained one-component typed ForEachEntity(EntityRef, in T) operations
O(sum present instances), not O(group size * all entities) membership tests
no repeated Visit per save or entity
snapshot not replaced by change-only data
explicit IDs used for non-primary registrations

10-structural.title: Remove defeated enemies from the world
criteria: query membership + Where health predicate + Destroy terminal
no structural mutation inside active callback
no manual target snapshot loop
reuse predicate operation

11-entity-only.title: Collect entities selected only by membership
criteria: zero-arity ForEachEntity is correct default
query membership only, no unnecessary typed rows
convert EntityRef to retained Entity
reused output/operation

12-target-list.title: Apply a command to an existing target list
criteria: explicit entity-list component-bearing ForEach + optional query
O(L), not whole-world O(N) scan+Contains
ref Health direct
prepare input snapshot once

13-group-cleanup.title: Remove components belonging to configured groups
criteria: GetGroup for Temp/Transient union, deduplicated
type-erased batch Remove, no CLR type discovery needed
query targets current entities, not initial fixture handles
prepare fixed group selection once
preserve primary float and unrelated registrations

14-debuff-ticks.title: Tick every configured interface debuff
criteria: construction-time constrained dispatch or equivalent prepared closed generic handlers
each configured registration visited independently including same-CLR alternatives
struct mutation by constrained call on actual stored ref; no boxed-copy mutation
live query rather than initial fixture entities
no unsupported interface-constrained runtime functor; documented generic-generator fallback accepted with its per-entity lookup cost

15-filtered-nearest.title: Find a minimum inside an external list
criteria: explicit-list typed ForEachEntity/read-only rows or equivalent linear list reduction
membership and value/radius eligibility before minimum
current player state refreshed before execution; same reference point for eligibility and distance
stable-ID tie break, stale generations excluded, no whole-world scan/full sort
retain live processing without caching an answer

16-damage-cleanup.title: Write health then destroy post-write matches
criteria: typed ForEach ref Health update completes first
value-filtered structural Destroy terminal reselects current post-write health
no immediate structural mutation inside callback
queries/operations retained; returned destroy count comes from terminal

17-observed-pipeline.title: Observe then apply event-fed membership cleanup
criteria: one retained ForEachChange subscription and per-call output clear
Removed handled without reading null ref; generation-safe Entity handles retained
cleanup limited to current Added/Modified nonpositive events
structural removal after observer callback completes, preferably batched by ID
no full-world health snapshot or per-call observer recreation

18-configured-transfer.title: Filter then order then consume fresh budget on configured rows
criteria: typed float access with explicit source/destination IDs in comparer/terminal
descending source then stable-ID tie break; supported sort-all/filter-terminal fallback with O(N log N) cost disclosed when explicit-ID predicates unavailable
ordered typed ForEach with direct ref source/destination; no world scan+point-getter rewrite
per-call budget reset before Invoke, capacity cap and partial final target
primary same-CLR registration untouched; live values/membership

19-expiring-effects.title: Tick unknown struct effects then remove expired instances
criteria: prepare constrained dispatch per configured registration outside Execute
mutate actual struct instance without boxing; include same-CLR alternative IDs
derive expiration from post-tick values and apply structural removal after traversal
batch per-registration cleanup or supported structural terminal; do not destroy entities
handle live entities and unconfigured interface implementations; document fallback access cost

20-snapshot-reset.title: Complete full snapshot before any reset
criteria: prepared per-registration typed read-only entity traversal, explicit IDs
snapshot every current instance on every call, including unchanged/unmarked values
global snapshot phase completes across all registrations before first reset
only then reset configured marked instances by constrained mutation on stored struct
no boxed mutation or repeated per-call type discovery; current membership/new entities

21-membership-transition.title: Choose structural matches from updated values
criteria: typed Health write phase over live Enemy/Health query
membership selectors inspect updated Health after write phase
post-traversal Add/Remove batch or structural terminals, no callback structural mutation
retain Paused for low-health entities and preserve non-enemies
reused preparation remains valid after topology and membership changes
